$comment: One line of `services.jsonl` in a run directory of run format 1.
description:
One line of `services.jsonl`: the service a claim name stands for started (`event`
`start`) or stopped (`stop`). A start with an `error` did not start; a stop with an
`error` raised while it stopped, and the service counts as stopped.

ts.description: when the start or the stop ended (UTC ISO 8601)
ts.title: Ts

name.description: the claim name the service stands for
name.title: Name

key.description: `start`: the task whose claim started it
key.title: Key

address.description: `start`: what the service gave its tasks to reach it; null for none
address.title: Address

error.description: the exception of a start that failed or a stop that raised; null when it went well
error.title: Error

wall_s.description: how long the start or the stop took, in seconds
wall_s.title: Wall S

title: ServiceEvent
